automaticHttpsRedirect.automaticTlsListener: ACME-managed certificates and HTTPS only; it does not create a separate HTTP socket implicitly
automaticHttpsRedirect.hostCoverage: the canonical request host must be covered by a hostname declared on the target listener; otherwise return 421 Misdirected Request without Location
automaticHttpsRedirect.location: https scheme + canonical request host + canonical request path + original query
automaticHttpsRedirect.sourceListener: an explicit HTTP listener with tls.mode=disabled, protocols=[http1], redirectToListenerId targeting a TLS-enabled HTTP listener, and no routes

exactPrefixGlob.normalization: reject non-canonical input instead of rewriting it
exactPrefixGlob.percentDecode: never; percent is an ordinary literal character
exactPrefixGlob.representation: already-decoded canonical absolute path text, not a URL or request-target
exactPrefixGlob.validation: reject NUL/control, invalid UTF-8, repeated slashes, and literal . or .. path segments; preserve trailing slash

regex.match: the regex match must cover the complete canonical request path
regex.validation: compile during SDK Reload candidate apply; reject invalid UTF-8 and NUL/control

glob.match: the glob must match the complete canonical request path
glob.tokenization: scan left to right and choose the longest token; ** is recognized before *; *** is ** followed by *

tokens.*: zero or more Unicode code points other than slash
tokens.**: zero or more Unicode code points including slash
tokens.?: exactly one Unicode code point other than slash

requestPath.dotSegments: remove RFC 3986 dot segments after percent decoding; parent segments above root stay at root
requestPath.percentDecode: strictly once, after splitting the query
requestPath.query: excluded from route matching and preserved unchanged for handlers
requestPath.repeatedSlashes: collapse to one slash after percent decoding
requestPath.source: HTTP request-target path before the first query delimiter; the query is kept separately
requestPath.trailingSlash: preserve when the decoded path ends with slash, slash-dot, or slash-dot-dot

socketAddress.format: host:port; IPv6 host must be bracketed
socketAddress.host: empty wildcard or IP literal only; DNS names are not bind addresses
socketAddress.ipv4: validated as a complete IPv4 literal
socketAddress.ipv6: validated with Go net/netip ParseAddr; zone identifiers are rejected
socketAddress.port: ASCII decimal integer 1 through 65535; leading zeroes are rejected

upstreamPool.eligibilityChange: reset current weights for all origins in the new eligible set
upstreamPool.noRetryOrExclusion: TLS handshake/verification failure and any failure after TCP connect
upstreamPool.passiveFailure: TCP connection refusal or timeout before request bytes; exclude only that origin for 30 seconds
upstreamPool.retry: at most one next eligible origin, only after TCP connect refusal or timeout before any request byte
selection: For each eligible origin, add its configured weight to its current weight.
Select the origin with the greatest current weight; ties use original array order.
Subtract the sum of eligible weights from the selected origin's current weight.
